🚀 ECC is absolutely exploding on GitHub right now, acting as a true "operating system" for AI coding agents!

If you are using tools like Claude Code or Cursor, you already know the bottleneck: constantly managing context, memory, skills, and security. Prompt fatigue and context degradation slow down even the best developers.

ECC (Agent Harness Operating System) solves this by providing a structured engineering workflow—plan, test, implement, review, verify, remember, and improve. Instead of manually rebuilding context in every prompt, ECC gives your AI assistants a unified framework that lasts across sessions.

🔥 Key Features:
• Massive Tooling: Packed with 68 specialized agents, 286 skills, and 94 legacy command shims for architecture, planning, security, and build repair.
• Persistent Context & Continuous Learning: Turns repeated wins and workflows into reusable skills and memory so you never have to re-explain project constraints.
• AgentShield Security: Built-in security scanning to protect your autonomous coding workflows against vulnerabilities and code leaks.
• Multi-Harness Support: Native support for Claude Code with adapters for Cursor, Zed, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and more.

Stop letting context limits slow down your development cycle. Install ECC once and give your AI coding assistant a complete engineering lifecycle that tests and reviews its own code.

Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC

Ever tried rendering over 2,200 individual 3D meshes in a browser without completely crashing the frame rate? 

Rendering massive, multi-part anatomical datasets in web applications has traditionally been an absolute performance nightmare. Every separate mesh usually means a separate draw call, which quickly brings even powerful GPUs to their knees. 

Enter human-atlas—a high-performance React and Three.js human body explorer that solves this exact complexity. It lets users seamlessly navigate, search, inspect, and explode thousands of body parts directly in the browser with zero performance degradation.

Here is why WebGL engineers and frontend devs are bookmarking this repository:

⚡ High-Performance Architecture: Instead of thousands of costly individual draw calls, it merges geometry into batches and utilizes per-structure GPU textures for translation, visibility, and selection.
🧬 Granular Anatomical Data: Features 2,234 individually selectable meshes, 15 anatomical systems, and 3,432 searchable named concepts packed into just ~33 MB of compressed geometry.
💥 Dynamic Exploded Views: Automatically calculates non-overlapping exploded layouts for both desktop and mobile to transition smoothly from an assembled body to an inventory of parts.
🛠️ Advanced Tooling: Includes comprehensive scripts for mesh validation and an optional WebMCP integration for advanced anatomy search.

Whether you are building EdTech health platforms or looking for a masterclass in WebGL and Three.js performance optimization, this is a production-ready blueprint for handling heavy data-visualization apps.

Explore the repository and check out the code here:
https://github.com/ashemag/human-atlas

Stop wasting hours trying to verbally explain UI layouts, padding, and state transitions to your AI coding assistant! 🛑

M3E Canvas bridges modern UI/UX design systems and AI code generation, letting you visually sketch Material 3 Expressive screens and instantly compile them into precise 'vibe-coding' prompts.

We’ve all been there: battling verbose text prompts to get Claude Code, Cursor, or your favorite AI tool to understand a complex frontend layout. M3E Canvas solves this friction by serving as a visual intermediate layer. You sketch the screens, and it generates structured, precise natural-language prompts that ensure clean, consistent UI generation on the very first try. 🚀

✨ Key Features:
• Material 3 Expressive UI & Magnetic Connections: Drag-and-drop toolkit with shape-morphing loaders and smart components that fuse dynamically.
• Interactive Flow & Responsive Preview: Multi-screen linking with directional transitions, swipe gestures, and instant scaling between mobile and desktop formats.
• Context-Aware Prompt Compiler: Automatically translates spatial layouts, z-order overlaps, and multi-screen relationships into structured prompts for your target stack.
• Zero-Backend Client-Side Architecture: Built as a static Next.js/React export relying on localStorage, with optional BYO-key AI integration.

Whether you are rapidly bootstrapping cross-platform mobile apps or mapping out complex multi-screen user journeys, this is the ultimate blueprint for your AI coding agents. 

Check out the repository and level up your vibe-coding workflow today:

Stop trusting your AI agent blindly. 🛑

Even the most advanced language models still hallucinate—especially during complex, context-heavy tasks like binary reverse engineering, low-level debugging, and heavy code refactoring. When an autonomous agent confidently asserts a false API definition or a broken code structure, it can silently ruin your pipeline.

Enter Reverify: a game-changing tool that stops AI hallucinations in their tracks by forcing models to propose code or claims that are strictly verified against deterministic ground-truth engines. 

Instead of letting an AI agent guess, Reverify intercepts its proposals via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server or CLI. It validates everything against a robust engine using PE/ELF/Mach-O parsers, pattern scanners, and CPU emulators, returning a strict VERIFIED or REFUTED verdict with real evidentiary bytes.

Key Features Built for Tech Pros:
🔍 Deterministic Ground-Truth Engine: Validates structural and behavioral claims using pure-Python cores and optional native libraries like Capstone, Unicorn, Lief, and Z3.
🔌 Native MCP Server & CLI: Integrates seamlessly with AI development environments like Claude Code, Cursor, and other agent workflows as a silent gatekeeper.
📦 Context Rollover (reverify rollover): Prevents context drift and token rot during long-running tasks by packaging session state into a clean handoff file.
📊 Information Weight & Core Refinement: Measures whether a verified claim is actually informative and non-repetitive (following FActScore principles), rejecting trivial assertions.

Whether you are building autonomous AI coding agents, doing security research, or handling complex binary analysis, you can finally establish a trustless execution pipeline where model-generated code is mathematically tested before ever hitting production.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub: https://github.com/2akouwu/reverify

Turn your local WeChat history into a searchable, privacy-first personal intelligence hub with Codex skills, daily briefs, and opportunity tracking. 🚀

Are you drowning in information overload and losing valuable context across endless chat histories? Managing high-volume professional communication can lead to missed messages, unfulfilled promises, and lost commercial opportunities. 

Wechat Intelligence Hub solves this by providing a local-first, read-only system that transforms your local WeChat data into actionable intelligence. It extracts contact histories, group chat topics, pending replies, and business opportunities, generating structured daily briefings and comprehensive reports without ever relying on cloud storage or invasive message-injection hooks.

Key features built for developers and power users:
🔒 Clean-Room Architecture: The `wechat-cli` and `rion-wechat-reader` handle schema-2 salt-key authorization and WCDB-compressed messages safely without modifying the WeChat client.
🤖 Codex Integration: Run natural language queries to search chat histories, summarize threads, track unfulfilled promises, and draft replies based on your personal profile.
📊 Dual-Format Reporting: Generate clean Markdown files for archiving and AI processing, plus interactive HTML dashboards equipped with global search, topic filtering, and an opportunity radar.

Whether you want to automate daily executive briefings or build secure, on-device data pipelines for encrypted databases, this is the ultimate reference implementation for agentic CLI design and privacy-first local data aggregation.

Check out the repository and start building:
